designSummary: Monthly proportions with confidence intervals and run charts for adoption and completeness; descriptive comparison with the historic reference.
sampleSize: To estimate completeness near 90 percent within 5 percentage points (95 percent confidence), about 140 reports per index question are needed over the study (1.96 squared times 0.09 divided by 0.0025, about 138). Sampling 25 per question per month gives 150 per question over six months. The historic reference of 150 reports (50 per question) estimates a completeness near 65 percent within about 13 points per question.
primaryAnalysis: Proportion with all key elements over the six months, by index question, with 95 percent confidence intervals; difference from the historic reference described with its interval and caveats.
secondaryAnalysis: Monthly run charts of adoption and completeness; median reporting time by month; referrer questionnaire scores.
missingData: Reports that cannot be classified are counted and reported.
software: Spreadsheet run charts; R for intervals.
overfittingGuards: Checklist and implied-element rule fixed in advance
No subgroup testing beyond the three index questions
summary: 150 reports per question over six months give intervals of about 5 points.
